entries.mechanism: Each low-income pre-2020 Walloon child residual equals the 2025-indexed Walloon Decree Article 13 low-income monthly social supplement, annualized. The statutory base is 55 EUR/month (Walloon decree of 8 February 2018, Article 13, be-wal/statutes/family_benefits/amounts.yaml); the applied 2025 amount is 68.39 EUR/month at pivot index 130.67 from the AVIQ February 2025 amount table (be/statutes/family_benefits/child_benefit_base_2025.yaml). By our reading, EUROMOD BE_2025 adds this indexed supplement to the LGAF transition amounts for pre-2020 children, which Walloon Articles 120, 123 and 128 rule out; EUROMOD's maintainers have not yet confirmed this reading. The age-0 new-system control cases match exactly.
